title: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.20942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RG

translated_title: vividRGB：通过强制聚焦注意力在RGB照片中进行多种视觉线索检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20942v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自然照片包含密集且重叠的结构，这些结构在整图视觉编码器的特征图中可能表达得较为微弱。我们提出了强制聚焦注意力及其Python实现vividRGB。FFA是一种与编码器无关的推理时程序，它将冻结的编码器应用于放大的、重叠的局部裁剪区域，对逆对齐的反射取平均，并在源坐标系中重建特征场。我们使用DINOv3 ViT-B/16，对来自草地植被、真菌网络、空中森林、珊瑚礁和浮游植物显微镜图像的50张高分辨率照片进行了评估。在五个领域中，FFA在5%或10%聚焦度下产生的平均RGB边缘边界F1分数高于直接DINOv3编码和自动SAM3掩膜。FFA的领域均值范围为0.244至0.596，而直接DINOv3为0.028-0.076，SAM3为0.020-0.090。定性特征图也显示出更精细的外观结构。这些结果涉及RG
tldr: 论文提出强制聚焦注意力（FFA）方法，通过在推理时对局部放大裁剪区域应用冻结编码器并重建特征场，在植被、真菌、森林、珊瑚礁等多种自然图像中显著提升视觉线索检测性能，大幅超越直接编码和SAM3方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces forced focused attention (FFA), an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged overlapping local crops and reconstructs feature fields, significantly improving visual cue detection across diverse natural image domains and outperforming direct encoding and SAM3 masks.
